14:41 local, 10:41 GMT, 16:11 IST: 7 drop catches in the innings. Zimbabwe only have themselves to blame for all that they are going through right now. Meanwhile, Afsar Zazai and Naseer Khan Maroofkhil get a grand round of applause around the circumference as they make their way back to the pavilion. There was plenty of anticipation around the new ball, and Muzarabani bowled his heart out in an attempt to dislodge the pair. Twice in this session, they dropped Maroofkhil and both off the bowling of Muzarabani. It's also worth noting that Zazai got dropped on 62. In fact, both drop catches came in the space of 5 balls. Been that kinda day for the visitors. That said, both Zazai and Maroofkhil deserve a massive chunk of credit for their never-say-never attitude and successfuly capping off a wicket-less session. Just one more session remains, and the ball isn't gonna get any younger. Can Zimbabwe create some magic? Or, are we in for yet another edge-of-the-seat thriller? Back in 20 to find out...
Evans doing some catching practice during the break. Has dropped a couple in this innings. Okay, the players are now making their way out for the final session. Can this pair pull off the improbable?
